zh.title: 台鐵因應中秋暨教師節連假加開158列次 8月25日開放訂票
zh.summary: 台鐵宣布中秋與教師節連假將加開158列次，並於8月25日零時起開放訂票。
body: 台鐵因應即將到來的中秋節與教師節連假，規劃相關的鐵路營運疏運措施。台鐵表示，為滿足連假期間民眾返鄉與出遊的乘車需求，將在連假期間加開總計158列次的各級列車，提升整體疏運服務能力。
針對中秋與教師節連假加開的158列次班車，台鐵訂於8月25日零時起開放旅客預訂車票。相關車票開放預訂後，旅客可透過各項指定訂票管道進行購票，提早完成連假期間的交通行程規劃。
台鐵提醒有乘車需求的旅客注意開放訂票時間，並留意連假期間加開車次的相關訊息，以利順利安排中秋與教師節連假期間的鐵路搭乘計畫。

en.title: Taiwan Railway to Add 158 Trains for Holidays with Ticket Sales Opening Aug 25
en.summary: Taiwan Railway will add 158 train services for upcoming holidays, opening booking on August 25.
body: Taiwan Railway has announced operational adjustments for the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays. To handle the expected increase in travel demand during the holiday period, the rail operator will add 158 extra train services.

Ticket sales for the additional 158 train services are scheduled to open at midnight on August 25. Passengers planning to travel during the holiday period can reserve their tickets through official booking channels starting from that time.
Taiwan Railway advises passengers seeking to travel during the Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holidays to check ticket availability and complete their bookings in advance.

zh.title: 德國首架F-35戰機完成總組裝 空軍研議加購15架
zh.summary: 德國首架F-35戰機完成總組裝；預計9月移交美國訓練；空軍研議加購15架
body: 洛克希德·馬丁公司證實，德國空軍首架編號為MG-01的F-35A戰鬥機已於美軍德州沃斯堡工廠完成總組裝，並轉移至最後塗裝階段。該架戰機預計將於2026年9月交付至美國阿肯色州埃賓空軍基地進行訓練，前八架戰機均將在該基地培訓人員，首批飛機預計於2027年底前抵達德國比歇爾空軍基地。
德國目前的採購計畫包含35架F-35A戰機，用以替換預計於2030年退役的龍捲風式戰機。德國空軍總監霍爾格·諾伊曼中將表示，空軍內部正研議加購至少15架F-35A戰機，但最終採購決策仍需由國防部做出一步核定。

en.title: Germany's First F-35A Enters Final Finishes as Luftwaffe Considers Buying 15 More
en.summary: Germany's first F-35A completes final assembly before US training, while Luftwaffe considers procuring 15 additional jets.
body: Lockheed Martin confirmed that Germany's first F-35A fighter jet, designated MG-01, has completed final assembly at its Fort Worth facility in Texas and moved to Aircraft Final Finishes. The aircraft is scheduled for delivery in September 2026 to Ebbing Air Force Base in Arkansas, where the initial eight German F-35s will support pilot training before the first jets arrive at Büchel Air Base in Germany by late 2027.

Germany currently maintains a program of record for 35 F-35A aircraft to partially replace its Panavia Tornado fleet, which is expected to retire by 2030. Luftwaffe chief Lt. Gen. Holger Neumann indicated that internal discussions are considering procuring at least 15 additional F-35As, though a formal decision remains pending with the German Ministry of Defence.

zh.title: 印度為蘇愷30MKI戰機研發Virupaksha主動陣列雷達
zh.summary: 印度研發Virupaksha主動陣列雷達；升級蘇愷30MKI戰機；提升多目標追蹤能力
body: 印度國防研究暨發展組織（DRDO）旗下電子與雷達發展機構正在為印度空軍蘇愷-30MKI（Su-30MKI）戰鬥機機隊開發「Virupaksha」國產主動電子掃描陣列（AESA）雷達，以取代現役俄製N011M Bars被動電子掃描陣列雷達。
該雷達配置約2,400個氮化鎵發射／接收模組，天線直徑約950公釐，並於2026年2月完成首次通電。官員指出該系統設計為4D雷達，能同時追蹤最多100個空中目標並引導6枚飛彈。DRDO並採用開發兼生產夥伴模式，結合Astra Microwave與Bharat Electronics等本土企業推動量產。

en.title: India Develops Virupaksha AESA Radar to Upgrade Su-30MKI Fighters
en.summary: India develops the Virupaksha AESA radar to upgrade Su-30MKI fighters; targets multi-object tracking.
body: India’s Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) is developing the indigenous "Virupaksha" active electronically scanned array (AESA) radar for the Indian Air Force's Su-30MKI fighter fleet. Designed by the Electronics and Radar Development Establishment, the new radar will replace the aircraft's Russian-origin N011M Bars passive electronically scanned array system.

The Virupaksha radar features an antenna measuring approximately 950mm in diameter with roughly 2,400 gallium nitride transmit/receive modules, achieving its first power-on in February 2026. Officials stated the 4D radar can track up to 100 airborne targets simultaneously and guide six missiles against separate targets. DRDO is partnering with domestic firms including Astra Microwave and Bharat Electronics for development and production.
